findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler with only `pass`. It leaves counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values and build_occurrence_and_event_data unimplemented, so they all remain abstract. When Detector.detector_handler calls group_type.detector_handler(self) for a metric_alert_fire detector, it raises TypeError. That breaks process_detectors for these detectors. Before this change the handler was a concrete no-op.

findings.title: PriorityLevel(new_status) can raise for DetectorPriorityLevel values
findings.body: The code converts DetectorPriorityLevel to PriorityLevel by integer value. If any non-OK DetectorPriorityLevel value has no matching PriorityLevel member, this raises ValueError during evaluation and aborts processing of the whole packet.

findings.title: Test passes wrong value for group_2; value argument never verified
findings.body: The expected occurrence for group_2 is built with value 6, but the packet's value for group_2 is 10. The test only passes because the mock builder ignores `value`. As a result, the tests never check that the correct value is forwarded to build_occurrence_and_event_data. Several other tests make the same mismatch, e.g. evaluating with 100 or 8 while building the expectation with 6.
